Message:
Since then, I trained hard,
and eventually set out on
a journey to save the world
with Guinevere and her friends.

We were going to
travel through “doors,”
and save different worlds
across a multitude
of time periods.

I-I knew I wasn’t cut out
for such a noble mission,
but spending time with everyone
was so much fun.

I figured I could tag along,
even if it was just to
carry their luggage...
Ehehe.

Day after day,
we defeated demons
and saved worlds together.
Our journey was going
smoothly so far.

Until one day,
the nun in our party, Elaine,
killed the Hero of the Staff...

And we all fell through
a broken “door,”
into an endless abyss...
